grinders.name: Fellow Opus Conical Burr Grinder (Opus 1; 40 mm burrs, 41 settings)
grinders.unitDetail: Outer grind ring 1 (fine) to 11 (coarse), 4 minor increments (0.25) per number = 41 outer settings; plus a removable inner calibration/micro ring under the load bin (6 notches each direction)
grinders.stepNote: Each quarter-setting click on the outer ring moves the burrs about 50 µm (so a whole number is about 200 µm). That’s burr movement, not the size of the grounds.
grinders.zeroNote: No explicit zero/touch-point definition found in fetched Opus 1 sources. Maker says inner ring "calibrates as burrs wear down" and can extend the outer ring to 0 and 12. Calibration procedure: center outer ring at 6, remove load bin, press calibration ring tabs, rotate outer ring to move the inner scale arrow (counterclockwise "-" finer, clockwise "+" coarser), release, and rotate outer ring to re-engage. (QA) Inner-ring calibration is separate from the 0-12 range extension; the help text does not define a numeric zero micron.
cautions: This chart is for the Opus 1; the Opus 2 calibrates differently.
